observations: Cameroon montage: Mount Cameroon, coastal waterfall landscape, Rhumsiki-style plugs, plain archaeological rock shelter and brick/green-roof Foumban palace. Natural drill (black face/pale fringe), forest elephant, giraffe in separate savanna zone. Hero invented cave paintings removed and palace corrected; cover fantasy craft figurine replaced with raffia/brass. No visible mosque/minaret, Islamic calligraphy or symbols. Avatar is a national forest montage: drill is associated with southwestern Cameroon; do not interpret as asserting it lives in Dja reserve. Geographic clusters are not literal adjacency. Exact historic geometry and animal taxonomy not certified.
depth: Approximate manually drawn animal/foreground/palace silhouettes, not measured depth.
